criteria.detail: Driver and runtime facts preserve loading, unavailable, partial/degraded and quarantined states without promotion.

criteria.criterion: grant 到期/撤销和配置开关后 profile 刷新
criteria.detail: Expiry is recomputed at refresh time, revocation denies the action, and the kill switch moves availability to disabled.

criteria.criterion: 工具实际拒绝与 profile 一致
criteria.detail: Tool presence alone yields requires-approval; a denied outcome is consistent only when the profile did not claim an executable action.

criteria.criterion: 重启后 effective state 恢复/降级可解释
criteria.detail: A stale pre-restart acknowledgement cannot prove post-restart execution; availability and driver become unknown.

criteria.criterion: 静态与 effective digest 可审计
criteria.detail: Static digest stays stable across effective changes while effective digest changes with facts and remains stable for observation-only updates.
